chapter: Reading bands, brass bands and Fate Marable
title: Fate Marable's boat band playing against Pichon on the Pelican
summary: Fate Marable would come after his boat job to play against Williams's band at dances and was well liked by Black audiences.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: Did Fayte ever come off the boat much to play jazz?

Yeah, he'd come and play it on the roof guard against us a lot of times. He'd come and play it on the Pelican. And I was playing with P. Shawne, he'd come and play a fine band. And Wilna Pfeiffer was playing with him.
Steady, he'd be on the boat pretty steady all the time.

Oh yeah, he'd come when he'd get off, after twelve o'clock. Oh I see. Oh yeah, when he got off. You see the hour dance used to run until two and three, you know, see, colored dances, you know. And he'd come after he'd get off and both bands would play against each other.
What kind of a rap did Fayte have with the colored people? Oh nice, nice reputation. They liked it? Yeah, they liked it. Yeah, they liked his band, nice band.
Played all together different from our band, musical band.
Well who would hire somebody like Fayte? Would the white people hire him too much, or out the boat?
